+def compute_radii(centers):
+    """Compute maximum radii for fixed centers using pairwise limits."""
+    n = len(centers)
+    r = [1.0 - math.hypot(x, y) for x, y in centers]
+    for i in range(n):

+        for j in range(i + 1, n):

+            r[i] = min(r[i], d / 2)
+            r[j] = min(r[j], d / 2)
+    eps = 1e-12
+    return [ri * (1 - eps) for ri in r]
